title: sloanea tieghemii
intro: Sloanea tieghemii, commonly known as the Philippine Sloanea, is a type of flowering plant native to the Philippines. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Sloanea tieghemii include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
